description: Executed plan of the FP16 toolchain bridge (llama.cpp b29c606e2 built with the jitLLM SDK) for the four P0 arms, from nsys CUDA traces, cuBLAS/cuBLASLt logs, cuobjdump SASS and an instrumented pool-peak copy. Reference only.

token_format.kernel: ["kernel", kernel id, grid, block, dynamic shared bytes, stream role or cublas#call]
token_format.memcpy: ["memcpy", kind, src memory, dst memory, bytes, stream role]
token_format.repeat: {"repeat": n, "body": [...]}: the body runs n times in a row

notes: 2026-09-25 on spark (GB10, driver 580.178.04). nsys 2025.3.2 --trace=cuda; cuBLAS 13.8.0.4 logging via CUBLAS_LOGINFO_DBG/CUBLAS_LOGDEST_DBG and CUBLASLT_LOG_LEVEL=5/CUBLASLT_LOG_FILE (all four honored). Profiled runs used the unmodified bridge; pool peaks come from separate runs of the fp16-pool-peak.patch copy. Both sets of runs reproduced the known logits bit for bit.

SASS: cuobjdump 13.0.85 -sass on the bridge executable and on each ggml-cuda object; text hash = instruction text without offsets or encodings, encoding hash = the 128-bit encodings in order. cuBLAS kernels live in libcublasLt and are identified by library hash, name and cuBLASLt algo only.
Chunk boundaries are the logits device-to-host copies (rows x 151936 x 4 bytes); a chunk's inputs are the pinned host-to-device copies that directly precede its first compute-stream operation.
